content.text: You’ve spent months producing your album, designing your cover art, and mastering your tracks. You’re ready to sell. But in Kenya, Stripe and PayPal aren’t options. Local [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-my-unfiltered-take-3|Payment Infrastructure]] gateways fail at scale. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-8|crypto]] is your only reliable channel—but how do you accept Bitcoin without depending on a third party that can shut you down? This isn’t a workaround. It’s sovereign commerce infrastructure. You own the code. You own the data. You own the revenue stream. No platform between you and your customers. No subscriptions. No KYC. No transaction limits. This is how you sell music online using Bitcoin—on infrastructure you control.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This is a complete [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-keeps|COREMERCH guide to digital]] commerce stack designed for creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. It’s not a plugin or a SaaS tool. It’s a combination of free and paid components deployed under your own accounts. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—static hosting platforms that don’t charge for bandwidth. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which execute code without servers. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, giving you full data ownership. File delivery is automated via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which verifies Bitcoin transactions on-chain and triggers instant product delivery. The system is modular, scalable, and entirely yours after deployment. No platform can shut you down, freeze your funds, or change the rules. You’re building on infrastructure, not renting it.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how the stack operates: A customer lands on your store, hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. They select a product—an album, a beat pack, or a preset kit—and pay in Bitcoin via NOWPayments. The payment is verified on-chain within minutes. A webhook fires, triggering a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script to log the order in Supabase or Google Sheets. The script then generates a secure, time-limited download link for the product, hosted on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and emails it to the customer. Every step is automated. You’re not managing inventory, processing payments, or handling delivery manually. The system is designed for digital products with instant delivery—music, ebooks, templates, plugins. It’s not e-commerce as you know it. It’s infrastructure engineered for creators who need to own their revenue streams.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and other regions where Stripe, PayPal, and local gateways fail. If you sell music, courses, templates, or software and can’t rely on conventional platforms, this is your solution. It’s for creators who understand that owning their infrastructure is the only way to guarantee long-term control. It’s not for those looking for a quick fix or a no-code tool. It’s for those who want to own their code, data, and revenue streams. If you’re selling beats, albums, or presets and need to accept Bitcoin without intermediaries, this stack gives you the tools to deploy a fully operational store in 48 hours. It’s not a workaround—it’s a permanent solution.
Own your revenue stream—no platforms, no subscriptions, no KYC.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack combines free and paid tools into a unified system. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides static hosting for your store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic, from order processing to file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 hosts your digital products. NOWPayments processes Bitcoin payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost, and sovereignty. You’re not locked into any platform. You can replace or upgrade components as needed. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes blueprints for all five stacks, full source code, and a scaling playbook. It’s the fastest way to deploy a sovereign commerce stack without starting from scratch.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours and includes GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments integration. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) adds Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and end-to-end testing. If you prefer to build yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and source code. Once deployed, load your products—albums, beats, presets—and set your Bitcoin pricing in USD. NOWPayments converts the price to BTC at transaction time, ensuring you receive the correct amount. Test every step: payment, order logging, file delivery. Once live, your store runs automatically. You own the code. You own the data. You own the revenue stream. This is how you sell music online—on your terms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell music online and accept Bitcoin without Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing. Automate file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and source code to deploy this infrastructure in 48 hours.

It’s the fastest way to own your infrastructure without starting from scratch. Available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for deployment in 48 hours, or Complete Builder Kit ($197) for DIY. 2. Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Connect order storage to Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Upload products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Integrate NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing. 7. Test payment, order logging, and file delivery. 8. Launch your store and start selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are deployed for you in 48 hours. The Complete Builder Kit includes full documentation and source code if you prefer to build yourself.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON—all under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to manage the infrastructure after deployment?
No. Once deployed, the stack runs automatically. You own the code and data but don’t need to manage servers or backend logic.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
No. This stack is designed for digital products with instant delivery—music, ebooks, templates, plugins. Physical products require different infrastructure.
What happens if Bitcoin’s price fluctuates?

NOWPayments converts the USD price to BTC at transaction time, ensuring you receive the correct amount regardless of price fluctuations."
